82K likes, 531 comments - deepikapadukone on October 9, 2026: "7 years ago on World Mental Health Day we launched The Deepika Padukone Closet, and soo many of you have joined our community since, to contribute towards Mental Health in India through your purchases. 

This year, I’m thrilled to launch Featured Closets - bringing in a broader circle of inspiring individuals to share pieces from their personal wardrobes!

Thank you @pvsindhu1 for agreeing to be our very first Featured Guest - in a world that often expects strength without struggle, your resilience, grace and grit have inspired millions!

PV Sindhu’s personal collection of prized jerseys are now up for sale at DeepikaPadukone.com/Closet 
(link in bio)

As always, proceeds support @tlllfoundation 🙏🏽

#WorldMentalHealthDay
#TheDeepikaPadukoneCloset".

271K likes, 4,214 comments - deepikapadukone on January 4, 2026: "I am beyond thrilled to launch my passion project - OnSet - an experiential learning program for technicians across various departments wanting to build a career in Indian film, television and advertising.

Visit onsetprogram.in, send in your work, tell us about yourself and stand a chance to work with or create with the best in the business!

I cannot wait to welcome the next generation of creative talent On Set!🎬".
